text:
claire_sales: Quick heads up — Arkadia Systems needs SOC2 excerpt + an external-scan attestation and a signed pen-test letter stub for their EU staging POC. They want materials by Fri EOD CET. Also asked for Dedicated EU pricing with KMS and 90d log retention.
rob_se: Copy. Who signs the attestation? Any custom wording requests expected? @emma_security
emma_security: I can sign the standard external-scan attestation and produce the redacted SOC2 excerpt. If they request "no warranty" language, route to legal; minor redlines okay. Need customer legal contact for signature block.
claire_sales: Contact is legal@arkadia.io (Sven Olaf). They confirmed no internal network diagrams for POC, just docs and cost.
jordi_ops: Dedicated EU + customer KMS in eu-west-1 covers residency. Lead time: KMS provisioning ~48 hours, log retention config same day. Ballpark: `dedicated-small: €7.5k/mo`, `kms: €220/mo`, `setup: €2.2k` (3-month commit cuts setup by 50%).
rob_se: Is an external blackbox scan sufficient for procurement?
emma_security: For POC, external scan + attestation is acceptable; for production they generally require a full pen-test. Will include that note in the attestation.
legal-bot: files uploaded: https://files.redwood.internal/compliance/SOC2_excerpt_redacted_Arkadia.pdf (expires in 6 days)
claire_sales: Perfect. I'll send the links to Sven and include the Dedicated pricing lines. If they confirm commit term I'll ask Jordi to waive half the setup fee.
jordi_ops: Noted. If they want a month-to-month, setup applies in full; 3+ months triggers discount.
emma_security: Drafts will be in the secure folder. If legal redlines, CC me + legal@redwood.com.
claire_sales: Thanks team — I'll update when Arkadia confirms. :white_check_mark:
